instrument: Regulation (EU) No 910/2014 as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1183 (eIDAS)
note: The European Digital Identity Wallet article inserted by Regulation (EU) 2024/1183 is Article 5a of Regulation (EU) No 910/2014; there is no Article 6a. Article 5a(4)(d) requires wallets to meet the Article 8 requirements for assurance level high. Cross-border acceptance is Article 5f. Question text and L3/L5 updated to match.

citation: EU AI Act Art. 10(2)(f) as amended by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 (Art. 10(5) deleted)
instrument: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (AI Act) as amended by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744
note: Art. 10(2)(f) (examination for biases likely to affect fundamental rights or lead to discrimination) read in CELEX 32024R1689; Art. 1 point (9)(b) of Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 deletes Art. 10(5), and its new Art. 4a now governs processing special categories of data for bias detection.
